question: In a certain code language, TOUGH is written as 20152178 and PLEAD is written as 1612514. How will CLOVE be written in the same language?
solution: The place value of the alphabet series: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76f0458cf503287c7152a13649b19ede6efc5098e2a6c7c73c7b08968987b5a3.png] The logic followed here is: **All the alphabets are coded by their position value.** TOUGH is written as 20152178
